# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## Reward mechanism (tau2 airline, this suite)
- Confirmed from evaluator source (not yet from a RESULT): all 10 val tasks use
  `reward_basis = ['DB','COMMUNICATE']`; reward is the MULTIPLICATIVE product of those two.
  ACTION checks exist in the trajectories but are NOT in the basis → the agent's exact
  tool-call arguments do not affect the score. DB = final DB equals gold's replayed
  end-state; COMMUNICATE = required string appears (case-insensitive, commas stripped,
  substring) in ANY assistant message. IMPLICATION for edits: fix DB with in-body
  computation (make the write policy-correct regardless of the agent's arg), and satisfy
  COMMUNICATE by returning the exact number in a relay-ready string.
- Verification method that gives a deterministic pre-gate signal: load tools.py via
  importlib and run a tool body against `FlightDB.load(AIRLINE_DB_PATH)` in the tau2 venv
  (`/vol/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/venv-skillberry-tau2/bin/python`, PYTHONPATH
  `.../tau2-bench/src`). System python3 lacks tau2.

## cand_0001 edits (awaiting RESULT stamp — do not treat as confirmed until stamped)
- What worked / didn't: unknown until the harness stamps the RESULT under the JOURNAL entry.
- Promising: additive READ tools (`list_user_reservations`, `preview_flight_change_cost`)
  + in-body baggage nonfree derivation + composite `update_reservation_passenger_name`.
  If the RESULT shows a DB task did not move, first check whether the runtime agent CALLED
  the tool — if not, the residual is selection (name/description salience), not capability.
